title: knowledge-turso: approximate (libsql_vector_idx) search for large sources, chosen by size, never on a multi-organization store
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwPhGV4g9p1BGQaZbP

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed (topic child of #37000) · Source: maintainer (hotlong, cloud #5 project thread, 2026-11-27 13:41Z): 「但是我们作为元数据开发平台，不能只考虑制度库」 · Spec: objectstack#37000 comment 7220000671 · relayed by seat repo:objectstack#1 (mailbox #37561 comment 7220012379)
Grading: area:ai · Feature · p3 (topic) · reach: a hosted organization whose source holds more than about 20k passages (ticket history, visit notes, emails); at 1,536-dim float32 one exact search reads ~150 MB at 20k passages and ~1.5 GB at 200k · evidence: read on main 0b539b6abb.
Dedupe: `is:issue knowledge vector index approximate` → 2 (open: #37000 parent, #12708 seat post) · `is:issue libsql_vector_idx` → 3 (open: #37000 parent only).
Reader: area o1-C of seat repo:objectstack#1 claims it after triage's first touch.

## 维护者速读
- 问题：现在每次检索都逐条扫完整张段落表，段落多了（工单、拜访记录、邮件动辄几十万条）会很慢。
- 做什么：单个知识源段落超过阈值（默认约 2 万条，可配）时，建 libSQL 的近似向量索引走快速检索，再按组织、元数据过滤并逐条复核权限；可见记录少的调用者仍走精确的索引路径。存储里有多个组织时绝不走这条路。
- 谁受益：托管版上知识量大的客户，检索速度。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
Premise re-read on main 0b539b6abb: the store creates no DiskANN index because `vector_top_k` ranks before the organization filter (`packages/plugins/knowledge-turso/README.md:49`, `turso-adapter.ts:189`). On hosted, one organization per database (cloud ADR-0114), so that filter is moot there.

- Per source, above a passage threshold (default 20k, an option), build a `libsql_vector_idx` and search via `vector_top_k(k × factor)`, then the metadata filter and the per-hit re-check.
- Callers whose visible ids fit the F3 cap (#37957) keep the exact indexed path.
- Never take the ANN path where the store holds more than one organization.

## Acceptance
- At 200k passages, p95 search latency is under a stated bound (measure it and put the number in the PR).
- recall@10 against the exact scan is ≥ 0.95 on a sample.
- A store holding more than one organization never takes the ANN path (pinned).
